# Window geometry observation is armed by each app, not by the dock host

Sub-issue of #13158 (dock layouts, multi-window). Found by @neo-opus-vega while rebasing PR #18059 onto #18068 and handed over as a Tier 2.5 finding on the window-manager surface; V-B-A'd here.

## Context

`Neo.manager.Window` is the one geometry authority for cross-window docking: `DragCoordinator` hit-tests `Window.getWindowAt(screenX, screenY)` on the pinned legacy path (`src/manager/DragCoordinator.mjs:856`, outer-rect based since #18068) and reads `innerRect` for the remote-drag acceptance offset. The manager's rows refresh from two sources only: the connect-time snapshot (`manager/Window.mjs#onWindowConnect`) and `windowPositionChange` payloads (`#onWindowPositionChange`, `Window.mjs:188-206`). Those payloads come from the Main-thread addon `Neo.main.addon.WindowPosition#publishGeometry` — behind two reactive configs the addon defaults to `false`: `observeMovement` (the config-owned poll, #18040; `checkMovement` publishes only when `screenLeft/Top` moved) and `observeResize` (`afterSetObserveResize` installs the `resize` listener; `onResize` ends in `publishGeometry()` — "A fixed-origin resize is still a geometry change").

## The Problem

Nothing in the engine arms either config. `grep -rn "observeResize\|observeMovement" src apps` on `dev@5ae9358063` finds exactly one consumer: `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:434` (the main render target at construction — its comment already names the case: "Movement snapshots alone go stale after a main-window resize") and `:3551` (each admitted tear-out vessel, awaited before the vessel is published to any ownership branch). Every other dock host is blind:

- `examples/dashboard/dock/MainContainer.mjs` (extends the engine host) arms nothing.
- The Fleet cockpit (neomjs/neo-agent-institution, `apps/agentos`) arms nothing: zero references to `WindowPosition` under its `apps/`.

For those hosts a main window that was moved or resized after connect keeps its connect-time `outerRect`, so a popup dragged beside the shrunk viewport is claimed by it (Vega's measured case), and a vessel never publishes its own movement at all — the native-titlebar popup→main drag (the demo's killer beat) has no geometry stream to run on. The Workstation works because it copied two lines the engine should own.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs` (`Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace`, the host every adopter extends since #17541 / #17546): `construct` (`:476`) creates the preview producer and, with `enableDockTearOutLifecycle`, subscribes `Neo.currentWorker.on({connect: this.onWindowConnect, disconnect: this.onWindowDisconnect})`; the admission path runs `admitTearOutConnection(context)` (`:940`, grant hook) and `afterTearOutWindowConnect(context)` (`:951`, observation hook) after engine ownership state is written; `reparentTearOutPane` (`:906`) moves the pane into `Neo.apps[windowId].mainView`.
- `src/main/addon/WindowPosition.mjs`: `observeMovement_` / `observeResize_` reactive configs (`:36-39`, `:113-121`), `publishGeometry` (`:164`, sends `windowPositionChange` with `getWindowData()` + `windowId`), `checkMovement` (`:141`), `onResize` (`:245-275`).
- `src/worker/App.mjs:833` forwards `windowPositionChange` to `Neo.manager.Window.onWindowPositionChange`.
- The unit precedent for stubbing the addon: `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs:432-478` (`Neo.main.addon.WindowPosition` swapped for a recorder); the engine host's own spec is `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockWorkspace.spec.mjs` (`onWindowConnect({windowId})` driven at `:1094`).

## The Fix

The engine host owns the arming; the app-level copies retire.

1. `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace#construct`: after `super.construct`, when `enableDockTearOutLifecycle` is on, `Neo.main.addon.WindowPosition?.setConfigs({observeMovement: true, observeResize: true, windowId: this.windowId})` for the host's own render target (the Workstation's `:434`, verbatim, one level down). Gate: only tear-out-enabled hosts run a poll — a plain dashboard pays nothing.
2. The admitted vessel: in the engine's `onWindowConnect` admission, arm the connecting window's Main realm the same way **before** the connection is published to any ownership branch and before `afterTearOutWindowConnect` (the ordering the Workstation's `:3551` comment demands: the header-action pop-out births the vessel with its titlebar under the pointer, so no `mouseout` ever arms the poll).
3. `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:434` and `:3551` delete; behaviour identical (the calls move, they do not change).
4. Method JSDoc on both sites states why the engine arms it (Anchor & Echo); ADR 0029's window-manager section gets one sentence: geometry observation is the dock host's, not the adopter's.

Consumer note: the Fleet cockpit does not extend the engine host yet; until it does, it inherits nothing from this leaf — its one-line arming is an institution leaf (not filed here; #13158's consumer rows own it).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit (`test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockWorkspace.spec.mjs`): constructing a tear-out-enabled `dock.Workspace` with a `windowId` records one `WindowPosition.setConfigs({observeMovement: true, observeResize: true, windowId})` on a stubbed addon; a host without `enableDockTearOutLifecycle` records none. Red on `dev` (no call today).
- [ ] Unit: `onWindowConnect({windowId})` for an admitted vessel records the same call for the vessel's `windowId`, and the recorder sees it **before** `afterTearOutWindowConnect` runs (ordering assertion). Red on `dev`.
- [ ] `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs` no longer calls `WindowPosition.setConfigs`; `unit/apps/workstation/Workspace.spec.mjs`, `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL` and `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` stay green (the calls moved down one class).
- [ ] Component (`test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockGeometryObservation.spec.mjs` on the `dock-popout` fixture — a tear-out host that arms nothing by hand): after a fixed-origin viewport resize the manager row read through the fixture's probe follows the new extents without any pointer or position change; the boot read is the control. Red on `dev`. (Amended 2026-09-02: the example dock app is not a tear-out host, so it is not the falsifier; the real-Chrome frame/viewport split stays with `WindowGeometryRealChromeNL`, unchanged.)
- [ ] No `observeResize` / `observeMovement` literal outside `src/` (grep-checkable); every tear-out-enabled host inherits the arming.

## Out of Scope

- The Fleet cockpit's adoption of the engine host (its own migration leaf) and its interim one-line arming (institution).
- Changing what `getWindowAt` hit-tests (#18068 settled outer-rect) or the claim arbiter.
- Poll cadence or the `mouseout` re-arm semantics (#18040).
